turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm retiring next year and I've no idea how to budget without a salary.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Big change. Do you want to start by working out your monthly costs, or by figuring out how much income you'll actually have?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, you've got a better eye than me. Which of these is sharper, the left or the right?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Zoom in on the eyes. The right one, I think. The left is a bit soft.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Annoying, the left has the better smile.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Can't you swap the faces or something?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That feels like cheating. Would you notice if I did?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Honestly? Nobody would notice except you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's exactly the problem. I'd notice every single time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We'd stopped at where to begin with the retirement budget. Ready?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Income. I need to know what's coming in before I panic.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good. Gather your pension letters and any savings, then we'll add it up.
